issues.issue: This is the only receipt line in the Water and Sewer funds, so business-type receipts are 100% 'other'. They are most likely utility charges, but the page prints no breakdown. Under the context-label rule and the 2026-11-12 ruling, leaving it as 'other' is defensible. It stays on the review list (detail[17] and detail[19] are the same).

The function Streets/Highways was inferred from the Street Fund column, not printed on the row. The 2026-11-12 FY2022/2023 ruling says to give a capital outlay function only when it is printed. The inference is defensible but it is a judgment call. detail[16] is the same.

The outstanding NDEE loan is printed only in the p5 debt schedule, not on the Exhibit A ending balance. It is mentioned in notes but not entered as a liability. This is consistent with the cash-basis Exhibit A scope.
